# Updated Files

`dev/workers.yaml`
```yaml
# Dev worker node group: 2 nodes, t3.medium (SPEC row: "Kubernetes cluster
# (EKS)"). This whole file is duplicated (not overlaid) in prod/workers.yaml
# with different replicas/instanceType - that duplication is what a bare,
# no-tooling arm costs.
apiVersion: cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: MachineDeployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  clusterName: myapp-dev
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      cluster.x-k8s.io/cluster-name: myapp-dev
  template:
    spec:
      clusterName: myapp-dev
      version: v1.31.2
      bootstrap:
        configRef:
          apiVersion: bootstrap.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
          kind: KubeadmConfig
          name: myapp-dev-workers
      infrastructureRef:
        apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
        kind: AWSMachineTemplate
        name: myapp-dev-workers
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: AWSMachineTemplate
metadata:
  name: myapp-dev-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      instanceType: t3.medium
      iamInstanceProfile: nodes
```

`prod/workers.yaml`
```yaml
# Prod worker node group: 4 nodes, t3.large (SPEC row: "Kubernetes cluster
# (EKS)"). This file is not a patch on dev/workers.yaml - it's a full,

# bare, no-tooling arm costs.
apiVersion: cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: MachineDeployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  clusterName: myapp-prod
  replicas: 6
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      cluster.x-k8s.io/cluster-name: myapp-prod
  template:
    spec:
      clusterName: myapp-prod
      version: v1.31.2
      bootstrap:
        configRef:
          apiVersion: bootstrap.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
          kind: KubeadmConfig
          name: myapp-prod-workers
      infrastructureRef:
        apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
        kind: AWSMachineTemplate
        name: myapp-prod-workers
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: AWSMachineTemplate
metadata:
  name: myapp-prod-workers
  namespace: clusters
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      instanceType: t3.large
      iamInstanceProfile: nodes
```

|---|---|---|---|
